comparison.objective: Seat a blind headrail in two gated brackets and close both retainers; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part transport, two-end alignment, insertion, and gate latching versus small-tool access and fine rotational tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Rail home within floor/back/tilt/depth tolerances and both gates shut; both spec versions agree.
comparison.reason: A meaningfully different insertion-and-latching ability; generic alignment and bimanual handling do not establish overlap.
